description_en: Queries the detailed information about a vServer group
description_zh: 查询虚拟服务器组的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-vserver-group-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vserver-group-id rsp-cige60000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVServerGroupAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vServer group
parameters.name: vserver_group_id

Description.description_en:
The description of the server group.

This parameter is not returned if the Description parameter is not specified in the request
Description.description_zh:
服务器组描述。

若用户未设置Description，则该参数不返回
Description.example: The description of the server group.

Port.description_en: The port that is used by the backend server
Port.description_zh: 后端服务器使用的端口

ServerId.description_en: The ID of the backend server

ServerIp.description_en: The IP address of the backend server

Type.description_en:
The type of backend server. Valid values:

ecs: ECS instance

eni: ENI

eci: elastic container instance
Type.description_zh:
后端服务器类型，取值：

ecs：ECS实例（默认）。
eni：弹性网卡实例。
eci：弹性容器实例

Weight.description_en: The weight of the backend server

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the CLB instance was created. The time follows the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
CreateTime.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的创建时间，格式：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the CLB instance

Tag.description_en: The tags of the backend server

TagKey.description_en:
The tag key. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`
TagKey.description_zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`

TagValue.description_en:
The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag value cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`
TagValue.description_zh:
实例的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`

VServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the vServer group

VServerGroupName.description_en: The name of the vServer group
